title: House Cleaning Service Checklist Form
subtitle: Residential House Cleaning: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: House Cleaning Service Checklist Form covers room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item. The home-cleaning service coordinator records Residential House Cleaning criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. House Cleaning Service Checklist Form keeps Residential House Cleaning exceptions visible until the home-cleaning service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use House Cleaning Service Checklist Form at residence, room sequence, access point, supply area, and excluded space. Document room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item identity before Residential House Cleaning begins. Compare room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item findings with stated Residential House Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential House Cleaning issues to cleaning quality reviewer.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential House Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence, room sequence, access point, supply area, and excluded space, and the linked room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item source.

fields.label: Room list and selected service level
Access, pet, alarm, fragile-item, and product restriction

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential House Cleaning facts for room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential House Cleaning inspection checks
items: High-touch, kitchen, bathroom, floor, and fixture condition
Stain, damage, delicate material, and do-not-clean marker

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Use observed Residential House Cleaning evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Home-Cleaning Service Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unknown spill, sharp, pest, or hazardous material
Fragile or damaged item without direction
Restricted room, privacy, or security boundary
Requested result requires restoration beyond cleaning
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential House Cleaning when an unknown exposure, damage, access, privacy, security, or scope boundary remains. Retain the available Residential House Cleaning proof and route unresolved room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item scope to home-cleaning service coordinator.
